note.after_visit_summary: Today we discussed your readiness to quit smoking. You smoke about a pack a day and have tried quitting before. We set your quit date for November 1st. Starting that day, use one 21 mg nicotine patch each day and 2 mg nicotine gum when you have cravings. Throw away lighters and ashtrays, and keep gum in your car to help with urges. You can call 1-800-QUIT-NOW for free support. We also ordered a colonoscopy referral because you're 52 and have never had one. A yearly lung cancer screening CT scan was ordered due to your smoking history. Labs for cholesterol and diabetes were requested. You received a flu shot in your left arm today. Return in 1 month to check on your quit progress and review lab results. Keep up the great work—quitting is the best thing you can do for your health.
